An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] '''training base''' was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[T'Charek Haathi]] was stationed there as a [[Flight instructor/Legends|Flight instructor]], and [[Arik Stijhl]] served as the base's [[Quartermaster/Legends|Quartermaster]].
